name: Hexxed
description: Collect a vast array of colors by mixing different color orbs using RGB based mixing instead of real life pigment mixing. Features battle mode, a strategic color-matching puzzle game where you connect orbs to discover new colors against another player in live timed battles. Also features achievements and fun customizable particle effects to go with a vibrant color discovery system. Master the art of color mixing across 330+ unique hues!
features: Customizable visual styles and particle effects
